name: services/crstests/user_grade
description: Get grade which a token issuer got in node specified by node_id parameter. Please see the note about automatic grading (algorithm note).
brief_description: Get student's grade for a single node.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A single TestGradeObject or an empty dictionary if a token issuer does not have grade in node.
